How it works

A camera ray intersects an asymmetric ellipsoid. Object-space bands and three oriented layer responses catch a moving light, while Fresnel color and a polished top reflection reveal depth. This is an artistic optical study, not measured nacre transport.

GLSL ES 3.00 → typed uniforms → Zustand vanilla store → raw WebGL2. The renderer owns frame time; semantic changes enter the store only on interaction. The 3 × 3 capture matrix records inputs, not visual or performance conclusions.

Motion Atlas / Experiment 001

Living Wireframe Mandala

A deterministic, geometry-first study after MechBullRodeo’s TouchDesigner tutorial. Independent Canvas2D interpretation, not an exported .toe network or a WebGL material.

Initializing geometry…

Geometry & motion

Reproducibility

Animated timestamps are quantized to 1/30 s for replay. Receipt stores normalized controls, frame time, source identity, and a non-cryptographic geometry fingerprint. Canvas output may vary by browser.

No microphone data, uploads, external scripts, or third-party network calls. A local static server is required for ES modules. Scene complexity is capped at 30,000 line segments per frame.

pages.title: Shader Gallery — Jennipher Troup (MelodicBloom)
pages.text:
Shader Gallery

Evidence-led WebGL2 material research by Jennipher Troup (MelodicBloom): interactive optical studies, procedural materials, and reproducible validation.

▶ Open the interactive gallery

Explore the studies below. Material Validation Lab trials advance with receipts; claims stay bounded until a named trial records them.

  • Shader Library
  • Abalone
  • Aurora

What this is aiming for

Growth here means a larger catalog of materials and rising mechanical accuracy: effects that respond correctly when the observer angle or light-source direction changes, instead of baking a single hero look.

The work targets known phenomenological mechanisms—subsurface scattering, layered angle-dependent spectral diffraction / thin-film interference, Fresnel and thickness-coupled response, roughness and metalness coupling, transmission and dispersion—expressed as optical parameters with explicit relationships and controlled scenarios (neutral view, grazing incidence, light sweep).

Current: interactive artistic optical studies and open validation trials. Not claimed yet: measured or calibrated physical accuracy. A compile or a pretty frame is not a pass.

Material research lineup

Three pilots are contracted in the Material Validation Lab. Validation runs in sequence because each receipt unlocks the next decision; the live demos above can be explored in parallel anytime.

  1. 1 · Planned Abalone / nacre baseline (MVT-ABALONE-001) — Khronos glTF iridescence maps under controlled light and view; channel semantics before any procedural nacre invents thickness. Anchors map–lighting relationships (intensity vs thickness channels, observer polar angle, key-light azimuth).
  2. 2 · Next Soap-bubble spectral thin film (MVT-BUBBLE-001) — Two-beam spectral / Fresnel treatment vs an RGB-proxy control; phase-consistent hue/intensity with thickness and incident/view angle. Decides whether spectral integration earns its cost.
  3. 3 · Queued Gold-foil field study (MVT-GOLD-001) — Original deterministic fold-height fields coupled to normal and roughness; directional highlight breakup that must survive three light directions, not a single hero pose.
Parallel vs sequence. Demos and hypothesis shaders can run side by side. Formal trials stay ordered: Abalone map semantics → Bubble spectral vs proxy → Gold foil lighting response → only then a broader Three.js / R3F adapter decision. Parallel trial execution would only make sense after Abalone’s channel/lighting receipt is no longer the blocker for the others.

Live demos

  • Gallery — interactive WebGL canvases
  • Live Shader Library v1 — manifest-driven shader previews
  • Abalone — iridescent nacre study (pairs with pilot 1)
  • Aurora — aurora field study

Evidence status

Built
The browser demos linked above, plus Lab contracts, records, and tooling.
Page smoke
Links provide entry points to individual studies. A loaded page alone does not verify rendering, frame rate, or material fidelity.
Lab
MVT-ABALONE-001 is planned; Bubble and Gold are also planned. Separate exploratory checks do not establish a completed pilot or calibrated physical accuracy.

Source and Lab docs: github.com/MelodicBloom/shader-gallery · Material Validation Lab under material-validation-lab/ · Live Shader Library v1 previews require WebGL2; Gallery, Abalone, and Aurora request WebGL 1. Static library previews remain available without live WebGL2.

pages.title: MVT-ABALONE-001 — Khronos Abalone Baseline · Material Validation Lab
pages.text:
Material Validation Lab · trial MVT-ABALONE-001

Khronos Abalone Baseline

Does the documented glTF iridescence map (R = intensity, G = thickness) behave as two independent controls under controlled light and view changes? This page is the experiment, not a finished material.

Result: loading receipt…

Mode
Map source
Geometry
Fixture

What the map actually contains

The iridescence texture packs two data channels. Shown here as greyscale, read without colour conversion.

Evidence chain

Problem
Iridescent “nacre” is easy to fake from one hero angle. Before inventing a procedural nacre, the lab needs a documented, licensed reference whose channels and response can be checked.
Decision
Use the Khronos IridescenceAbalone asset as a comparison fixture in an isolated Three.js lane (conflict ledger C-01, C-03), not as the gallery’s material and not via a dependency migration.
Implementation
Pinned asset commit + SHA-256 verified before parsing; Three.js 0.186.1 locked in this folder only; neutral control, R-only and G-only isolation fixtures; three controlled captures and a machine-readable receipt produced by one command.
Human-control boundary
The script measures load, channel colour-space and pixel differences. Whether the response looks right at neutral, grazing and sweep is a human review; the trial cannot pass without a named reviewer.
Claimed
Only what receipt.json marks measured.
Not claimed
Measured abalone optics, physical calibration, mineral simulation, an original material, mobile optimisation, frame rates, or KHR extension conformance of any WebGL2 proxy.
